# Subway Seat for Emacs

Three themes in one package, for Emacs 27.1 and later. They cover the tree-sitter font-lock faces and org, magit, vertico, corfu, company and which-key.

[Emacs](https://www.gnu.org/software/emacs/) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/emacs/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat-theme.el`](subway-seat-theme.el) | a directory on `load-path` and `custom-theme-load-path` (or install the package) |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel-theme.el`](subway-seat-tunnel-theme.el) | a directory on `load-path` and `custom-theme-load-path` (or install the package) |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel-theme.el`](subway-seat-enamel-theme.el) | a directory on `load-path` and `custom-theme-load-path` (or install the package) |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in init.el, with the three files on `load-path` and `custom-theme-load-path` (or installed as a package):

```elisp
(load-theme 'subway-seat t)
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in init.el, with the three files on `load-path` and `custom-theme-load-path` (or installed as a package):

```elisp
(load-theme 'subway-seat-tunnel t)
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in init.el, with the three files on `load-path` and `custom-theme-load-path` (or installed as a package):

```elisp
(load-theme 'subway-seat-enamel t)
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
